visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Full-width blue banner image with left-aligned white headline and pill CTA overlaid; photo background belongs to the hero block, so the section is not colored. visual-trees hint was default-content but the banner image + overlay text is a hero.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-leading banner: full-bleed image with the main headline and a CTA overlaid
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width banner image with left-aligned headline and pill CTA overlaid

contentPattern.summary: Text overlaid on a full-bleed banner image is a hero; the photo background belongs to the block (section not colored). Banner text is the page's main headline, authored as h1.
contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: h1 headline, optional text, and a standalone link (rendered as a button)

usage: Top of a page to feature one announcement (e.g. earnings) with a single CTA.
reuseGuidance: Use for any full-width image banner with overlaid headline + CTA. Use the base hero for a simple centered hero.
